item.title: Title Myth Buster: “You always have to use the title company your agent recommends.”
item.description: Not true. In Florida, you have the right to choose your own title company and that choice matters more than most people realize. The title company plays a key role in protecting your transaction, reviewing ownership history, clearing liens, and ensuring a smooth closing. The goal is not just to…
item.content:encoded:
Not true.

In Florida, you have the right to choose your own title company and that choice matters more than most people realize.

The title company plays a key role in protecting your transaction, reviewing ownership history, clearing liens, and ensuring a smooth closing. The goal is not just to close the deal but to close it correctly and securely.

At Firm Title TB, we believe clients deserve clarity, transparency, and confidence throughout the closing process, no matter how simple or complex the transaction.

Have questions about title or closing? We are here to help break it down.

item.title: Hurricane Season Is Here: Are You Ready?
item.description: As we head into the start of hurricane season in Tampa Bay, now is the time to prepare before storms are on the radar. A few quick essentials to check off your list: 🏠 Secure outdoor furniture and loose items around your home 🌳 Trim trees and remove weak or overhanging branches 🔦 Restock…
item.content:encoded:
As we head into the start of hurricane season in Tampa Bay, now is the time to prepare before storms are on the radar.

A few quick essentials to check off your list:
🏠 Secure outdoor furniture and loose items around your home
🌳 Trim trees and remove weak or overhanging branches
🔦 Restock emergency kits with flashlights, batteries, water, and first aid supplies
📄 Review insurance policies and keep important documents in a safe, dry place
📱 Make sure you have backup charging options for your devices

And don’t forget the title side of things: make sure your home’s title and closing documents are organized and accessible. Having everything in order now helps reduce stress if you ever need to move quickly after a storm.

At Firm Title TB, we’re here to help protect what matters most, so you can focus on staying safe and prepared.

Stay ready, Tampa Bay.

#FirmTitleTB #HurricaneSeason #TampaBay #StormPrep #FloridaRealEstate #BePrepared

item.content:encoded:
⚓ Master Plan Proposed for the Port of St. Petersburg

A major long-term vision is taking shape for St. Pete’s waterfront, with plans to transform the Port of St. Petersburg into a vibrant mixed-use marine destination over the next 20 years.

📈 Key Highlights & Features
🔹 Estimated Project Cost: $158M–$270M (excluding design, soft costs, and future pricing)
🔹 Phased 20-Year Development Plan: Funding expected through grants and private partnerships
🔹 Four Acres of Waterfront Activation: Designed to enhance tourism, recreation, and marine operations
🔹 Harborside Park & Restaurant: New public gathering spaces along the waterfront
🔹 Cruise Terminal Pier: Expanded tourism and cruise opportunities for the region
🔹 Marine Operations Center: Supporting the city’s growing marine infrastructure
🔹 Superyacht Marina & Repair Facility: Docks for recreational vessels alongside maintenance and overhaul capabilities

✨ Why This Matters for Tampa Bay Growth
Projects like this continue to position St. Petersburg and the greater Tampa Bay region as a premier waterfront destination for tourism, marine industry, and economic development. Long-term infrastructure investments along the waterfront can create significant impacts on local business growth, property values, and regional investment opportunities.

📍 Firm Title TB is proud to support the continued evolution of Tampa Bay through secure and seamless residential and commercial real estate transactions.

item.content:encoded:
🎨 Salvador Dalí Museum Expansion Coming to St. Pete
The iconic Dalí Museum in downtown St. Petersburg is set to undergo a major $65 million expansion, further elevating Tampa Bay’s cultural and tourism landscape.

📈 Key Updates & Features
🔹 $65M Expansion Project: Funded through private donations, corporate sponsorships, grants, and tourism development support
🔹 35,000 Sq. Ft. Addition: Significant new space dedicated to arts and education
🔹 New Gallery Spaces: Designed for rotating and traveling exhibitions
🔹 Expanded Learning Centers: Programs for K-12 students and adult education initiatives
🔹 Community Event Spaces: Flexible areas to support local programming and cultural events
🔹 Timeline: Construction expected to begin Fall 2026 with completion anticipated in 2028

✨ Why This Matters for Tampa Bay Growth
This expansion reinforces St. Petersburg’s position as a premier arts and cultural destination while continuing to drive tourism, education, and economic development across the region. Major investments like this contribute to long-term property value growth and strengthen the appeal of Tampa Bay as a nationally recognized place to live, work, and invest.
